name: net_coop_difficulty_health
description: VUH-2194 health only: host normal overrides friend hard; native three-Soldier wave gets two-player 1.6x current/max HP once, then host damage and death mirror. No population or damage-to-player scaling.

steps.expr: location(0)==[5,6,0,1,2,0] and location(1)==location(0) and len(actors(0))>0 and len(actors(1))>0
log_count('[coop-difficulty] room role=host mode=1 players=2 mob=1600 boss=1300',0)>0 and log_count('[coop-difficulty] room role=client mode=1 players=2 mob=1600 boss=1300',1)>0
steps.message: Peers did not report the same host-selected two-player room factors

steps.expr: len([a for a in enemies(0) if a['name']=='M_EX010' and a['hp']>0])==3 and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)
log_matches(r'\[coop-difficulty\] scale frame=\d+ objectId=301 actor=[0-9A-F]+ players=2 mode=1 hp=(?P<hp>\d+)->(?P<scaledHp>\d+) max=(?P<max>\d+)->(?P<scaledMax>\d+)',0)

len(saved['scale_rows'])==3 and all(int(r['scaledHp'])==(int(r['hp'])*1600+999)//1000 and int(r['scaledMax'])==(int(r['max'])*1600+999)//1000 for r in saved['scale_rows']) and all(a['hp']==a['maxHp']==int(saved['scale_rows'][0]['scaledMax']) for peer in saved['scaled'] for a in peer if a['name']=='M_EX010')
steps.message: Host current/max HP was not scaled once by 1.6 and mirrored natively on friend

steps.expr: enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1) and all(a['hp']==a['maxHp']-3 for a in enemies(1) if a['name']=='M_EX010')

steps.message: Enemy health scaled again after ordinary damage

steps.expr: len(enemy_hps(0))==0 and len(enemy_hps(1))==0 and log_count('[enemysync] host death',0)>=3 and log_count('host death netId',1)>=3
